description: Each criterion has an uncertain finding in the before or the after report, or both. The noul criteria follow the movement rule of FR-37: faint-body-text drops from 0.5 to 0.2 and faint-chart-labels drops from 0.96 to 0.55, so both are better. The choice criterion line-length and the score criterion single-focal-point have no defect probability, so their changes stay uncertain (FR-27, FR-37).
